comment: Only add entries here when the verify script intentionally references a non-live fixture, snapshot, or planned-for-rename path. Stale moved sources do NOT belong here — fix the script instead. Every entry MUST have all five fields: path, reason, owner, expiresAt, addedBy. The meta-gate refuses to load an entry missing any field. Entries with expiresAt in the past are rejected outright (the gate fails fast so the allowlist cannot rot).
